data.summary: The CR‑002 Random‑forest PD challenger was evaluated against the champion benchmark using a hold‑out sample and out‑of‑time data. Performance indicators include {{m:run_45ac60:gini.train}} (Gini — train), {{m:run_45ac60:gini.test}} (Gini — test), {{m:run_45ac60:gini.oot}} (Gini — out‑of‑time (simulated)), {{m:run_45ac60:ks.oot}} (KS — out‑of‑time), {{m:run_45ac60:auc.holdout}} (AUC — hold‑out), {{m:run_45ac60:brier.holdout}} (Brier score — hold‑out), {{m:run_45ac60:calibration_ratio.holdout}} (Predicted × observed — hold‑out), {{m:run_45ac60:bad_rate.holdout}} (Observed outcome rate — hold‑out), {{m:run_45ac60:approval_rate.holdout}} (Approval rate at coded cutoff), {{m:run_45ac60:gini.champion.holdout}} (Champion Gini — hold‑out) and {{m:run_45ac60:gini.challenger.holdout}} (Challenger Gini — hold‑out). The parity check against legacy scoring is represented by {{m:run_45ac60:rows_scored}} (parity vs legacy: rows_scored). The review identified {{m:run_45ac60:findings.high}} (Number of high‑severity findings), {{m:run_45ac60:findings.medium}} (Number of medium‑severity findings) and a total of {{m:run_45ac60:findings.total}} (Number of findings). The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
